# Draft:Continuity Software

----
Continuity Software is a cybersecurity vendor that secures enterprise storage and backup systems, to help protect organizations’ data and enable data recoverability in case of a breach. Continuity’s flagship product, StorageGuard, detects all security misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, automatically prioritized  by business impact, and with clear remediation guidelines..
History
In 2005, Gil Hecht and his team of storage and data protection experts established Continuity Software. The company is focused on a single mission;to provide enterprise security and IT leaders with the cyber resilience solutions they need in order to guarantee that critical data is continuously secure.
Products
StorageGuard
StorageGuard provides continuous protections of enterprise storage and backup systems; detecting security misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, remediating them, and guaranteeing their compliance with security regulations and standards
StorageGuard checks the security of storage and backup systems at three levels: the management plane, the data plane and the recovery plane. It performs checks for the configurations of storage and backup systems in various areas such as authentication, authorization, encryption audit logging, administrative access, services and protocols, interfaces and ports, Storage Area Network (SAN), ransomware protection, time synchronization, data access and more.
StorageGuard also detects when storage and backup systems are exposed to security advisories, security bulletins, security alerts and Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs).
StorageGuard provides support for a wide variety of storage and backup technologies, including block storage arrays, storage network switches, Storage Area Network (SAN) , data protection appliances, storage virtualization systems, Network Attached Storage (NAS) , storage management applications, and Server-based SAN (Virtual SAN). StorageGuard provides data protection by securing storage and backup systems, which enables businesses to better protect their data.
StorageGuard supports hundreds of storage and backup devices, including those manufactured by Amazon, Azure, Brocade, Cisco, Cohesity, Commvault, Dell EMC, Hitachi, HPE, IBM, Infinidat, NetApp, Pure Storage, Rubrik, Veritas, Veeam, and VMware.
AvailabilityGuard
AvailabilityGuard helps organizations run smoothly and avoid unplanned downtime, outages, and data loss. It proactively eliminates single-points-of-failure that affect the entire IT stack before they impact business.
In addition, AvailabiltyGuard validates recoverability and data protection, including RPO and retention goals. This is carried out through scanning of all relevant IT systems and components, including databases, file systems, and storage to proactively detect resiliency risks and identify misconfigurations that affect the recoverability of organizations’ data.
Partnerships
Their product StorageGuard detects security misconfigurations and vulnerabilities across hundreds of storage and backup devices, including Amazon, Azure, Brocade (Broadcom), Cisco, Cohesity, Commvault, Dell EMC, Hitachi Vantara, HPE, IBM, Infinidat, NetApp, Pure Storage, Rubrik, Veritas, Veeam, and VMware.

Recognition
Continuity initially got recognized because of their strategic partnerships with top-tier enterprises and unparalleled cybersecurity solutions, but their recognition rose to fame when their CTO, Doron Pinhas, co-authored the NIST Special Publication 800-209
Continuity also won the Cybersecurity Breakthrough Award for Vulnerability Management Solution of the Year 2022.
Continuity™ was named;
* ‘Sample Vendor’ in Gartner® Report: Hype Cycle™ for Storage and Data Protection Technologies, 2023.
* ‘Sample Vendor’ in Gartner® Report: Hype Cycle™ for Storage Technologies, 2024.
* ‘Sample Vendor’ in Gartner® Report: Hype Cycle™ for Backup and Data Protection Technologies, 2024.
* ‘Representative Vendor’ in Gartner® Report: ‘Innovation Insight for Cyberstorage Solutions to Protect Unstructured Data Against Ransomware.
